title: Remove SQLite Runtime and Migrate to PostgreSQL

complexity.rationale: System-wide database runtime migration touching repositories, route handlers, CMS/public rendering, scripts, dependency manifests, and auth/session-adjacent code.

constraints: Do not keep SQLite as an active runtime fallback.
Do not keep better-sqlite3 or @types/better-sqlite3 in app dependencies.
Do not change public/CMS UI design, layout, copy, colors, or route structure.
Do not store absolute local filesystem paths in DB or browser-facing fields.
Do not delete crawled source files or public/images assets.
